title: Transport of the singular ideal by an equivalence
statement: For commutative R-algebras A and B and an R-algebra equivalence e:A≃B, the ideal image e(H_A/R) is contained in H_B/R [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal].

source.place: Definition 07C5 and Situation 07F7; invariance under algebra equivalence

proof.text: The equivalence induces an R-algebra equivalence A_a≃B_e(a), by the localization equivalence for the image of the powers submonoid. Smoothness transfers by Algebra.Smooth.of_equiv. Thus the image of the span of smooth elements lies in the corresponding span. Ideal.map_radical_le and monotonicity of the radical give the claimed inclusion.
